name: Yasaka
source:
Masaya's and Takeo's boss. A calm, cool and collected man who dislikes troubles.

[spoiler] An orphan, he was found and raised by the Cult Leader. Despite lacking special abilities, Yasaka is a very formidable opponent due to his extraordinary fighting skills, tough mentality and meticulous preparation. [/spoiler]
